android.desc:
Kocial is your go-to news app, bringing you the latest headlines from trusted national and international sources. It summarizes news into bite-sized formats of 10-word News, making it quick and easy to stay informed. Kocial delivers concise news stories personalized just for you in English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujrati and other International News. Whether you’re interested in politics, Bollywood, or world news, Kocial offers unbiased, fact-driven updates on current affairs—helping you stay on top of what matters most, fast.

Key Features of Kocial:

1. Fast, Crisp News Summaries:

Get the top news stories summarized in 60 seconds or less, without any opinions—just the essential facts. Whether it’s breaking news or entertainment updates, Kocial gives you the information you need, in no time.

2. Personalized News Feed:

Kocial learns your preferences as you read, creating a personalized feed of stories, videos, and content that cater to your interests. Your feed is updated with the latest news and stories from categories like politics, technology, sports, and more.

3. Comprehensive News Categories:

Kocial curates news from a wide range of topics, including:
India
Politics
Entertainment
Technology
World News
Sports
And more—all in one place.

4. Stay Updated on the Go:

Get real-time notifications on the most important and breaking news of the day. Plus, place the Kocial widget on your home screen for instant access to headlines.

5. Share the News
Easily share news stories across popular platforms like Facebook, WhatsApp, Reddit, and more. With Kocial, you can keep your friends and family updated too.

6. Built for Your Privacy:

At Kocial, we take your privacy seriously. The app doesn’t access your photos, videos, or other media, make calls, or save or distribute device information. We require almost No permissions:

7. Podcast Options
Listen to various motivating, inspirational stories and podcast while you read other news and join debate.

If you’re preparing for exams like UPSC, CAT, XAT, or other government job exams, Kocial is your fastest source for current affairs. Stay ahead with timely news and updates.

Download Kocial Today!

Experience a new way to consume news. Whether it’s Bollywood updates, sports headlines, or breaking news, Kocial delivers all the day’s top stories in one beautifully designed, fast-loading interface.

Download Kocial today to save time and stay informed!
